speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-Infectious Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS-D).

The combination of acute infectious exposure (camping with a sick contact), resolution of the initial infection (normal stool exam), and the persistence of chronic symptoms like urgency, cramping relieved by defecation, and incomplete evacuation is classic for post-infectious IBS. The normal inflammatory markers further support a functional disorder over Inflammatory Bowel Disease.
